mutations.name: reentrant-exit-bypasses-quit-guard
mutations.why: A missing quit guard lets repeated or reentrant callers enqueue multiple exits instead of retaining the first exit transaction.

mutations.name: answer-before-acceptance
mutations.why: A successful answer must not precede accepted exit state.

mutations.name: relaunch-before-child-exit
mutations.why: Finalizing before the old child ends starts a second instance alongside it.

mutations.name: close-stdin-before-receipt
mutations.why: Closing stdin during an accepted exit lets EOF force failure before the answer arrives.

mutations.name: accepted-death-reported-as-crash
mutations.why: Death after acceptance is not classified as an unexpected pre-exit failure.
